title: Podfile.lock with no `SPEC CHECKSUMS` block
description: Podfile.lock declares a lockfile that records no pod checksums. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
limitation: It matches a lockfile that records no pod checksums in the parsed Podfile.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
